title: Build deterministic math generators
goal: Create deterministic math problem generators that return problem text, variables, correct answer, worked solution, difficulty, and tags.
context: For math, code generates the problem and answer. LLMs may style text later but must not be the calculator.
acceptance: Generators return problem text, variables, correct answer, worked solution, difficulty, tags, and seed/lineage metadata
Fractions generator has seeded tests and correct answers
Percents generator has seeded tests and correct answers
Probability generator has seeded tests and correct answers
Linear equations generator has seeded tests and correct answers
Area/perimeter generator has seeded tests and correct answers
notes: Keep generator plugins small and reproducible by seed.
